dict.string: ActivityTracker reads the active tab's URL and title from your browser (e.g. Chrome) so it can roll up your browsing time per site. This never leaves your Mac.
ActivityTracker reads the focused window's title of the frontmost app so it can label your activity timeline. This never leaves your Mac.
ActivityTracker can optionally take periodic screenshots for your own review. This feature is off by default and, when enabled, screenshots are stored only on this Mac.
ActivityTracker counts keyboard/mouse events (never their content) to compute a per-minute activity score.
